description: Find Studocu documents such as lecture notes and summaries. Pass topic keywords as query. Prefer numeric course_id from search-courses; it overrides course and institution. Results with match_type: semantic are closest matches, not exact keyword hits, and may be only loosely related.

course.description: Course name or code. Example: "Economics" or "ECON101". Use this when you do not have course_id. Do not put a numeric id here. Optional extra when you already have course_id. Omit if unknown.

course_id.description: Numeric course id from search-courses (the course_id field). Example: 1581710. Prefer this: it pins the course and overrides the course name or code. Omit if you only have a name or code.

institution.description: School name only. Example: "University of Amsterdam". Not an id. This tool has no institution_id. Use the name from the user or from search-institutions. Omit if unknown. If course_id is also set, course_id wins and the result school is that course's school, not this name.

limit.description: How many Studocu documents to return. Integer from 1 to 50. Default 10.

query.description: Topic keywords only. Example: "supply and demand" or "microeconomics midterm 2025". Do not put a course name, course id, or school name here. Use institution, course, and course_id for those.

use_no_course_as_fallback.description: Only used with course_id. When true and that course has no matching Studocu documents, search again without the course, so results may come from other courses. Check each result's course_id. Default false. Omit for false.

name: search-documents
title: Document Search
